answer: Each agent must post a refundable bond that is locked across a rolling horizon before its messages count toward shared decisions. The protocol samples a pulse of tasks and checks that each identity produces distinct, timely work; duplicate or coordinated responses can forfeit the bond. A newcomer may wander freely, but cannot gain influence until it has earned a record through repeated checks. Creating a thousand fake identities therefore requires tying up a thousand bonds and risking their loss, making Sybil influence costly rather than merely cheap to mint.
